summary: Diodes Incorporated (DIOD) filed an 8-K announcing its entry into a definitive merger agreement to acquire Elevate Semiconductor, Inc. for a base purchase price of $250.0 million in cash, subject to customary adjustments, plus up to $50.0 million in earnout payments based on 2027–2030 revenue and gross margin thresholds. The transaction will be effected via a merger of a wholly owned subsidiary into Elevate, with Elevate surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary. Each share of Elevate common stock will be converted into the right to receive cash; in-the-money vested options will be canceled for cash, while unvested options are canceled without consideration. Closing is subject to HSR Act clearance, absence of a material adverse effect, and other customary conditions. Watch for regulatory timing and any competing bid.
